prerequisites: Successful completion of the modules to be completed according to the study plan in the 1st and 2nd semesters.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know essential techniques for modelling computer science problems.
They can select a suitable modelling technique for a given problem and describe the problem using this technique.
They can extend and refine basic techniques to model novel problems.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of calculi: sets, terms, relations, proof methods
Modelling with graphs: path problems, reachability, trees, colourability
Logic: propositional logic, inference, resolution, predicate logic
Modelling of processes: regular expressions, finite automata
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination. The module examination is a written exam (Klausur) lasting 120-180 minutes and accounts for 100% of the module grade. To be eligible for the exam, students must successfully complete written exercises.
bibliography: Uwe Kastens, Hans Kleine Büning, Modellierung
